reviews.title: Must pay to access
reviews.text: I am sorry, but buying this app was a complete waste of my time. As soon as you open the app, you have to pay even though downloading the app is free so while yes, it is allowed. It is tricking you into thinking that it’s free when really you have to pay. And since I am not allowed to make payments on my iPad due to some restrictions, I was not able to use the app. This is why I am giving it one star even though I’m sure there are lots of great features on the app. Once you do make the payment if you are allowed to. My one suggestion for the developer is that they clearly stayed in the app description that you must payin the app before you can use it.

reviews.title: Miss the old ui bit things change
reviews.text:
I really loved it before when I paid for the vocal effects, but the app has been revamped and a lot of people really like it.  I am glad it is getting the attention it deserves 
  I was really only into it for the vocal effects because I think that they are some of the best on iOS.
I mean their are some really good vocoder apps for iOS and this one is definitely on my list of them

I can’t say that I want them to only go back to doing vocals but if they made just an small vocal app or split this app into two types of subscriptions (one for vocal effects and one for full productions) that would be amazing..   
It just kind of stinks because I paid when the app first came out for vocal effects. Now, those vocal effects are gone unless I subscribe. I think the app is fabulous, but I wish they would have grandfathered in the vocal effects that were paid for like they did when they turned this into a sub subscription model.  I understand it’s some hip-hop style production app, but it’s lacking in the true ability for making beats and controlling them with MIDI – so it’s just basically a toy now. If they went back and made a Voloco audio effect app that would be wonderful. Because this was one of the best quick vocoder apps out there when it was first released. I don’t need all the extras and I paid and it’s a shame that they just can’t restore the vocal effects for the people who paid for them and let all the extra production stuff be subscription so people can enjoy that as well.

reviews.title: Single users with multiple accounts
reviews.text: I'm concerned about the possibility for the Voloco team creating multiple accounts to listen each other's profiles on a loop and therefore manipulate the number of streams. This is becoming quite obvious, since single users even collaborate with themselves through their multiple accounts. The vocals between profiles are edited, but in most cases I can still tell is the same person. So the same profiles are featured and could significantly change the performance of using the boost option. Don't get me started on the recent flood of AI generated tracks and beats. I thought Voloco was a recording app, but I guess I could make a bunch of accounts, use SUNO for each impersonation, and boost myself to #1.

reviews.title: Worse Recording App Ever
reviews.text: This app is not it. At first I thought VoLoco was gonna help me record music on my phone, but it’s super limited. You only get ONE take to record and no way to layer vocals unless you pay for premium. How are artists supposed to add ad-libs, stacks, harmonies or even fix timing with only one track? That makes no sense when layering is a basic part of making music. On top of that, the UI feels frustrating because you can’t move vocals around to get on beat. I switched to BandLab because it actually lets you record multiple takes for free. VoLoco seriously needs to update if they want to support real creators. Right now it feels like a paywall instead of a recording app. Disappointed. What about the people who can’t afford it
